name: needrestart-lxc restart
description:
Restart the services inside LXC containers that use outdated libraries, on one Proxmox host.

- **Dry run** (default) shows exactly what would be restarted and does nothing.
- **Restart** runs `needrestart-lxc -r`: every flagged service is restarted (`systemctl restart`, with escalation to kill + start and SIGKILL when KillMode leaves children behind). Non-systemd processes and scope units are reported but never touched automatically.

Optionally limit the run to one container (CTID or name) and/or exclude services matching a regex (e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: Optional: only this container (CTID or container name).

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional: regex of services to exclude (can use alternation, e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Dry run only shows what would happen.

values_ui_mapping.dry-run: Dry run (show what would be restarted)
